meanings.usage: 复数形式为firemen，指男性消防员，女性为firefighter
常用短语in the forest, forest fire(森林火灾)
cause + n. 表示导致某事发生
the cause of... 表示...的原因
examine + n. 表示对某物进行仔细检查
修饰动词，表示意外地做某事
常用复数remains，表示动植物的残骸或遗迹
remain + adj./n. 表示保持某种状态
泛指蛇类动物，无复数变化
wind的过去式，wound round表示缠绕在...上
只修饰名词，如electric wire电线
简写为V，用于表示电压大小
固定搭配，指传输电力的线路
an explanation of/for something 表示对某事的解释
spark + n. 表示引发某事

examples.en: Firemen have put out a big forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员已经扑灭了一场大规模的森林火灾。

examples.en: They have been trying to find out how the fire began.
examples.zh: 他们一直试图查明这场火是怎么烧起来的。

examples.en: Cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away often cause fires.
examples.zh: 人们随意扔掉的烟头经常引发火灾。

examples.en: He was able to solve the mystery.
examples.zh: 他能够解开这个谜团。

examples.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
examples.zh: 就这样，他能够解开这个谜团。

examples.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground.
examples.zh: 一只鸟从地上把蛇抓了起来。

examples.en: The bird dropped it on to the wires.
examples.zh: 那只鸟把蛇扔到了电线上。

examples.en: The snake wound itself round the wires.
examples.zh: 蛇把自己缠绕在电线上。

examples.en: It sent sparks down to the ground.
examples.zh: 它把火花送到地面上。

examples.en: At last firemen have put out a big forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员们终于扑灭了一场大规模的森林火灾。

sentences.en: At last fireman have put out a big forest fire in California.
sentences.zh: 消防队员终于扑灭了加利福尼亚州的一场森林大火。

sentences.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，他们一直在努力查明火灾是如何开始的。

sentences.en: Forest fires are often caused by broken glass or by cigarette ends which people carelessly throw away.
sentences.zh: 森林火灾通常是由碎玻璃或人们随意丢弃的烟头引起的。

sentences.en: Yesterday the fireman examined the ground carefully,
sentences.zh: 昨天消防队员仔细检查了地面，

sentences.en: but were not able to find any broken glass.
sentences.zh: 但没能找到任何碎玻璃。

sentences.en: They were also quite sure that a cigarette end did not start the fire.
sentences.zh: 他们也相当确定不是烟头引起的火灾。

sentences.en: This morning, however, a fireman accidentally discovered the cause.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天早上，一名消防队员偶然发现了起火原因。

sentences.en: He noticed the remains of a snake which was wound round the electric wires of a 16, 000-volt power line.
sentences.zh: 他发现了一条缠绕在16000伏高压电线上的蛇的残骸。

sentences.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
sentences.zh: 就这样，他解开了这个谜团。

sentences.en: The explanation was simple but very unusual.
sentences.zh: 解释很简单，但非常不同寻常。

sentences.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
sentences.zh: 一只鸟从地上抓起这条蛇，然后把它掉到了电线上。

sentences.en: The snake then wound itself round the wires.
When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground and these immediately started a fire.
sentences.zh: 当它这样做时，它向地面发出了火花，这些火花立刻引发了一场火灾。

grammar.title: 现在完成时 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示过去发生的事件对现在有影响，或从过去持续到现在的动作。常与already, yet, just, since, for等时间副词连用。
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去发生并已完成，但强调与现在的联系的事件。

examples.en: Firemen have put out a big forest fire.
examples.zh: 消防员已经扑灭了一场大规模的森林火灾。

examples.en: They have been trying to find out how the fire began.
examples.zh: 他们一直试图查明火灾是怎么发生的。

grammar.title: 现在完成进行时 (Present Perfect Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示从过去开始一直持续到现在并可能继续下去的动作，强调动作的持续性。
grammar.structure: 主语 + have/has + been + 动词-ing形式
grammar.usage: 用于强调动作持续进行了一定时间。

examples.en: They have been trying to find out how the fire began.
examples.zh: 他们一直在努力查明火灾发生的原因。

grammar.title: 过去进行时 (Past Continuous)
grammar.definition: 表示过去某一时刻或时间段正在进行的动作。
grammar.structure: 主语 + was/were + 动词-ing形式
grammar.usage: 用于描述过去正在发生的动作，常与when, while等连用。

examples.en: A fireman was examining the ground when he discovered the snake.
examples.zh: 一位消防员正在检查地面时发现了那条蛇。

patterns.pattern: Since + 时间点, 主语 + have/has + 过去分词

original.en: Since then, they have been trying to find out how the fire began.
original.zh: 从那以后，他们一直试图查明火灾发生的原因。

examples.en: Since last week, I have been learning English.
examples.zh: 从上个月开始，我一直在学英语。

examples.en: Since 2020, he has been working here.
examples.zh: 自从2020年以来，他一直在这里工作。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + be able to + 动词原形

original.en: In this way, he was able to solve the mystery.
original.zh: 就这样，他能够解开这个谜团。

examples.en: She was able to finish the work on time.
examples.zh: 她能够按时完成工作。

examples.en: Were you able to understand the story?
examples.zh: 你能理解这个故事吗？

patterns.pattern: When + 主语 + 动词-ed, 主语 + 动词-ed

original.en: When it did so, it sent sparks down to the ground.
original.zh: 当它这样做时，它把火花送到地面上。

examples.en: When he arrived home, it began to rain.
examples.zh: 当他到家时，开始下雨了。

examples.en: When she saw the snake, she screamed.
examples.zh: 当她看到蛇时，她尖叫起来。

patterns.pattern: 主语 + 动词 + 宾语 + 介词短语

original.en: A bird had snatched up the snake from the ground and then dropped it on to the wires.
original.zh: 一只鸟从地上把蛇抓起来，然后把它扔到了电线上。

examples.en: The cat caught the mouse from the corner.
examples.zh: 猫从角落里抓住了老鼠。

examples.en: He picked up the book from the floor.
examples.zh: 他从地板上捡起了书。
